factual_fidelity.evidence: Title claims 'garage' but inputs list parking; also 'parquet en chêne' (oak parquet) — inputs only say 'parquet flooring', species not specified. Two fabricated specifics.

completeness.evidence: Covers 280 m², 5 chambres, 3 salles de bains, jardin SW, cheminée, parquet, îlot, double four, cave, stationnement, Strassen.

native_quality.evidence: Idiomatic French throughout ('portes-fenêtres', 'plan de travail en granit', 'exposition sud-ouest'); 'habitation familiale de belle envergure' is slightly heavy.

market_fit.evidence: Uses LU/FR vocabulary like 'villa individuelle', 'cave', 'emplacement de stationnement privatif' which fits athome.lu corpus.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class supplied and description omits CPE — correct v1.5+ default.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 11 words with neighborhood + adjective; 5 CamelCase hashtags but 'EspaceEtLuminosite' is generic and 'CharmeLuxembourgeois' borderline generic.

tone_discipline.evidence: 'lumineux et chaleureux', 'atmosphère accueillante et élégante', 'ensoleillement optimal' are promotional adjective stacks, though no banned hyperbole.

fair_housing.evidence: 'habitation familiale de belle envergure' references family use — mild steering signal, less explicit than EN/DE versions but still present.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 2 — 'parquet en chêne' (species not in inputs, photo analysis only says 'parquet flooring') and 'façades blanchies à la chaux' (inputs say 'white plaster facade', not lime-washed); 'garage' in title is also stronger than 'parking'. Other claims supported.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: All three languages agree on 280 m², 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, SW garden, parking, cellar, fireplace, sale context. Minor disagreement: DE and FR titles say 'Garage'/'garage' while EN says 'Parking', and FR adds 'parquet en chêne' (oak) which DE/EN do not specify — non-contradictory but a small divergence.

notes: Oak parquet and lime-wash facade are fabricated specifics.
